scope: Actual C cached-class copy and dirty-bit operations, all uint16 requested lengths against124, matched mapped sizes0..1024, full-word mismatches, no-copy errors, port/record mutation and pointer reload, ignored callback returns, health wrappers and guarded state/registers/stack
limitations: Port tables, callbacks and class records are controlled fixtures; complete allocation, global port/handle initialization, actual locking, concurrency and flash persistence remain unresolved.

Original compiler/link identity, exact instructions, complete image linking and physical behavior remain unproven.
